performanceBudgetStatus: Latency budgets remain provisional; no prior-run nominal regression baseline supplied

capacityScope.qualification: Only observed attempts and commits; configured limits do not establish actual maximum capacity.

applicationMemory.scope: Kernel peak resident memory for this Python benchmark process, including retained object identities and embedded native libraries; excludes the separate PostgreSQL server. Lifetime peak does not reset between selected cases. Cache size is an object-graph estimate, not a process ceiling.

defaultListByteBudgetControl.scope: Original default query budget retained; no partial rows released on limit refusal

cases.indexWorkload: Unique business-key properties; optional nonunique lookup indexes not represented

napkinMath.model: T(n) = fixedMs + n * perRowMs, fitted to median atomic groups 1 and 100
napkinMath.qualification: Local estimate only; no extrapolated atomic support beyond the configured and exercised limit. Requires independent batch sizes and repeated runs before a budget is agreed.

scope: Actual public workflows on isolated local PostgreSQL. Connection reopen, not server restart. Cold server/install separate. Only the selected generated cases; indexes are unique business-key properties.

sqlSubmissionCounts.scope: Cursor execute submissions counted by direct psycopg and PsycopgHost channels; executemany API calls are counted separately because psycopg may pipeline multiple parameter sets. Python connection.commit()/rollback() calls and high-level host adoption/group-context acquisition calls are reported separately. Includes setup, SAVEPOINT, observers, payload, timeout SET, RELEASE, and cleanup submissions occurring inside each workflow case. Query text and parameters are inspected transiently for fixed SQL-class labels, then discarded.
sqlSubmissionCounts.operationCountScope: Per-operation counts include nested timed calls; operation summary rows overlap and must not be summed across operation names. Per-case totals are disjoint across selected cases and include untimed workflow setup/adoption/context calls.
